ps: CS/CS/SB 920 expands liability protections to include “traversing or crossing for the purpose of ingress and egress to and from, and access to and from, public lands or lands owned or leased by a state agency which are used for outdoor recreational purposes.” This additional liability protection may encourage private property owners to make areas available to the public for outdoor recreational purposes. The bill creates an exception where an owner of an area used for outdoor recreational purposes may derive revenue from concessions or special events and retain liability protection if such revenue is used exclusively to maintain, manage, and improve the outdoor recreational area. This may result in an indeterminate, positive fiscal impact on private property owners that derive such revenue and retain the liability protection. BILL: CS/CS/SB 920 Page 5
